arxiv-2105-08048.title: Wealth rheology
arxiv-2105-08048.creator: Zdzislaw Burda, Malgorzata J. Krawczyk, Krzysztof Malarz, Malgorzata Snarska
arxiv-2105-08048.description: Abstract We study wealth rank correlations in a simple model of macroeconomy. To quantify rank correlations between wealth rankings at different times, we use Kendall’s τ \tau and Spearman’s ρ \rho , Goodman–Kruskal’s γ \gamma , and the lists’ overlap ratio.

arxiv-2106-04344.title: Simulating time-varying strong lenses 2020 Simulating time-varying strong lenses –
arxiv-2106-04344.creator: G. Vernardos
arxiv-2106-04344.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by G. Vernardos. We present a self-consistent and versatile forward modelling software package that can produce time series and pixel-level simulations of time-varying strongly lensed systems. The time dimension, which needs to take into account different physical mechanisms for variability such as microlensing, has been missing from existing approaches and it is of direct relevance to time delay, and consequently H 0 H_{\mathrm{0}} , measurements and caustic crossing event predictions.

arxiv-2209-05022.title: PoseIt : A Visual-Tactile Dataset of Holding Poses for Grasp Stability Analysis
arxiv-2209-05022.creator: Shubham Kanitkar, Helen Jiang, Wenzhen Yuan
arxiv-2209-05022.description: Abstract When humans grasp objects in the real world, we often move our arms to hold the object in a different pose where we can use it. In contrast, typical lab settings only study the stability of the grasp immediately after lifting, without any subsequent re-positioning of the arm.

arxiv-2212-13106.title: Complexified spinor fields in operator form
arxiv-2212-13106.creator: Slobodan Prvanović
arxiv-2212-13106.description: Abstract The formalism of quantum field theory in operator form, based on the anti self-adjoint operators of the imaginary coordinate and momentum and the self-adjoint operators of the real coordinate, momentum, energy and time, is used in considerations of the spinor fields and related topics. The unitary representation of the Lorentz boosts in the spin-orbital space is given.

arxiv-2304-07990.title: Novel Quality Measure and Efficient Resolution of Convex Hull Pricing for Unit Commitment Journal: IJEPES
arxiv-2304-07990.creator: Mikhail A. Bragin, Farhan Hyder, Bing Yan, Peter B. Luh, Jinye Zhao, Feng Zhao, Dane A. Schiro, Tongxin Zheng
arxiv-2304-07990.description: Abstract Electricity prices determined by economic dispatch that do not consider fixed costs may lead to significant uplift payments. However, when fixed costs are included, prices become non-monotonic with respect to demand, which can adversely impact market transparency. To overcome this issue, convex hull (CH) pricing has been introduced for unit commitment with fixed costs.

arxiv-2305-00415.title: Cosmological Distances And Hubble Tension In Einstein-Cartan Theory
arxiv-2305-00415.creator: Siamak Akhshabi, Saboura Zamani
arxiv-2305-00415.description: Abstract We analyze the measurement of cosmological distances in the presence of torsion in both Einstein-Cartan and Poincaré gauge theory of gravity. Using the modified cosmological distance measurements, we use the observed time delays in gravitational lensing systems to determine the Hubble parameter.

arxiv-2306-13452.title: A Graph Neural Network Approach for Temporal Mesh Blending and Correspondence
arxiv-2306-13452.creator: Aalok Gangopadhyay, Abhinav Narayan Harish, Prajwal Singh, Shanmuganathan Raman
arxiv-2306-13452.description: Abstract 1 Introduction When we observe a human performing a motion, such as walking, running, crawling, or jumping, it is easy for us to recognize and distinguish them. By observing an action sequence, even if it is short-duration, our internal understanding of motion enables us to estimate the action sequence in the near past or near future.

arxiv-2310-20594.title: Tracially Complete C ∗ C^{*} -algebras Thanks: This work was supported by: long term structural funding – a Methusalem grant of the Flemish Government (Castillejos); UNAM-PAPIIT IA103124 (Castillejos); Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) – Project-ID 427320536 – SFB 144
arxiv-2310-20594.creator: José R. Carrión, Jorge Castillejos, Samuel Evington, James Gabe, Christopher Schafhauser, Aaron Tikuisis, Stuart White
arxiv-2310-20594.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by José R. Carrión, Jorge Castillejos, Samuel Evington, James Gabe, Christopher Schafhauser, Aaron Tikuisis, Stuart White. We introduce a new class of operator algebras – tracially complete C ∗ C^{*} -algebras – as a vehicle for transferring ideas and results between C ∗ C^{*} -algebras and their tracial von Neumann algebra completions. We obtain structure and classification results for amenable tracially complete C ∗ C^{*} -algebras satisfying an appropriate version of Murray and von Neumann’s property Γ \Gamma for II 1 factors.

arxiv-2501-11385.title: Sparse Incremental Aggregation in Satellite Federated Learning Thanks: This work is supported by the German Research Foundation (DFG) under Grant EXC 2077 (University Allowance).
arxiv-2501-11385.creator: Nasrin Razmi 1 2 , Sourav Mukherjee 1 2 , Bho Matthiesen 1 2 , Armin Dekorsy 1 2 , Petar Popovski 3 1
arxiv-2501-11385.description: Abstract This paper studies Federated Learning (FL) in low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellations, where satellites are connected via intra-orbit inter-satellite links (ISLs) to their neighboring satellites. During the FL training process, satellites in each orbit forward gradients from nearby satellites, which are eventually transferred to the parameter server (PS).

arxiv-2501-17237.title: Two-body charmed baryon nonleptonic weak decays with decuplet baryon involving S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) SU(3) breaking effects
arxiv-2501-17237.creator: Chao-Qiang Geng 1 , Chia-Wei Liu 2 and Sheng-Lin Liu 1,3,4
arxiv-2501-17237.description: Abstract We study the singly charmed baryon two-body decays of 𝐁 c → 𝐁 D ​ P \mathbf{B}_{c}\rightarrow\mathbf{B}_{D}P under S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) F SU(3)_{F} flavor symmetry, where 𝐁 c {\bf B}_{c} refers to anti-triplet singly charmed baryons, and 𝐁 D {\bf B}_{D} and P P denote decuplet baryons and pseudoscalar mesons, respectively.

arxiv-2502-02346.title: Sensitivity of Double Deeply Virtual Compton Scattering observables to Generalized Parton Distributions
arxiv-2502-02346.creator: J. S. Alvarado, M. Hoballah, E. Voutier
arxiv-2502-02346.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by J. S. Alvarado, M. Hoballah, E. Voutier. Double Deeply Virtual Compton Scattering (DDVCS) is a promising channel for Generalized Parton Distribution (GPD) studies as it is a generalization of the Deeply Virtual Compton Scattering (DVCS) and Timelike Compton Scattering (TCS) processes. Contrary to DVCS and TCS, the GPD phase space accessed through DDVCS is not constrained by on-shell conditions on the incoming and outgoing photons thus allowing unrestricted GPD extraction from experimental observables.

pmc-10703325.title: Situational assessment of empathy and compassion: Predicting prosociality using a video-based task
pmc-10703325.creator: Gabriela Górska, Aviva Berkovich-Ohana, Olga Klimecki, Fynn-Mathis Trautwein, Xianglong Zeng, Xianglong Zeng, Xianglong Zeng
pmc-10703325.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Classical psychometric approaches in social science measure individuals’ tendency to experience empathy and compassion. Using abstract questionnaire items, they place high demand on subjects’ capacity to introspect, memorize, and generalize the corresponding emotions. We employed a Socio-affective Video Task (SoVT)—an alternative approach that measures situationally elicited emotions—and assessed its predictive power over prosocial behavior against classical questionnaires in a sample of Israeli university students.

pmc-11342495.title: Coverage of policies to improve antimicrobial stewardship in human medicine in low and middle income countries: results from the Global Survey of Experts on Antimicrobial Resistance
pmc-11342495.creator: Kyaw Zay Ya, Mark J Lambiris, Gillian A Levine, Fabrizio Tediosi, Günther Fink
pmc-11342495.description: BackgroundAntimicrobial resistance (AMR) constitutes a major threat to global health. While antimicrobial misuse or overuse is one of the main drivers for AMR, little is known about the extent to which antibiotic misuse is due to a lack of national government-led efforts to enforce rational use in low and middle-income countries (LMICs).

pmc-11355833.title: New and Interesting Pine-Associated Hyphomycetes from China
pmc-11355833.creator: Wen-Hui Tian, Yan Jin, Yue-Chi Liao, Turki Kh Faraj, Xin-Yong Guo, Sajeewa S N Maharachchikumbura, Tamotsu Hoshino
pmc-11355833.description: Pine trees play a crucial role in the forests of Sichuan Province, boasting rich species diversity and a lengthy evolutionary history. However, research and investigation on fungi associated with pine trees are insufficient. This study investigated the diversity of hyphomycetes fungi associated with pine trees in Sichuan Province, China.

pmc-11517590.title: Significant pre-post effects on a patient-reported outcome measure in inpatient rehabilitation
pmc-11517590.creator: M Marquardt, M Utsch, A Zembic, F Basedow, G Garuffi, S Tobler
pmc-11517590.description: BackgroundWe conducted a pilot study for the Swiss National Association for Quality Development in Hospitals and Clinics (ANQ) in the inpatient rehabilitation setting. The aim was to assess the suitability of a generic health-related quality of life patient-reported outcome measure (PROM) as an outcome quality indicator for public reporting across all rehabilitation domains on a national level.

pmc-11679160.title: Energy-Efficient Wireless Multimedia Sensor Nodes for Plant Proximal Monitoring
pmc-11679160.creator: Daniele Trinchero, Giovanni Paolo Colucci, Elena Filipescu, Ussama Syed Muhammad Zafar, Paola Battilani
pmc-11679160.description: The paper presents a double-radio wireless multimedia sensor node (WMSN) with a camera on board, designed for plant proximal monitoring. Camera sensor nodes represent an effective solution to monitor the crop at the leaf or fruit scale, with details that cannot be retrieved with the same precision through satellites or unnamed aerial vehicles (UAVs).

pmc-12483537.creator: Shinji YAMASHITA, Fumitaka MATSUMOTO, Hironobu OKUYAMA, Natsuki OGASAWARA, Mitsuru TAMURA, Tomoki KAWANO, Kiyotaka YOKOGAMI, Takumi KIWAKI, Tsuyoshi FUKUSHIMA, Yuichiro SATO, Takumi TOMONAGA, Yoshiko OKITA
pmc-12483537.description: A 5-year-old boy presented to our hospital with ptosis and an abnormal ocular position. Magnetic resonance imaging showed a well-defined mass measuring 20 mm in diameter in the medial sphenoid bone extending to the orbit and compressing the external ocular muscle.

pmc-12592451.title: FZD6 mediates the contributing role of miR-199a-5p in the adipogenesis of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells derived from aplastic anemia
pmc-12592451.creator: Xianning Zhang, Huanhuan Zhang, Saisai Ren, Wenjuan Zhang, Qian Huang, Wenhui Huang, Lulu Liu, Mingkang Yao, Haihui Liu, Hao Zhang, Mingtai Chen
pmc-12592451.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Accumulating evidence indicates that enhanced adipogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BM-MSCs) derived from aplastic anemia (AA) could contribute to the excessive fat accumulation in the bone marrow. However, the underlying molecular mechanism remains to be determined. Here in this study, we further characterized the contributing role of miR-199a-5p in adipogenesis of AA BM-MSCs through specific inhibition of miR-199a-5p expression.

pmc-12683610.title: Reciprocal Dynamics of Therapeutic Alliance and Depressive Symptoms in Inpatient Cognitive Behavioural Analysis System of Psychotherapy: The Role of Attachment Insecurity
pmc-12683610.creator: Mona L. Diehm, Julia I. Kunz, Stephan Goerigk, Johannes Wolf, Jennifer Lange, Andrea Jobst, Frank Padberg, Matthias A. Reinhard
pmc-12683610.description: BackgroundPersistent depressive disorder (PDD) is marked by interpersonal dysfunction, presenting significant challenges for effective treatment. The Cognitive Behavioural Analysis System of Psychotherapy (CBASP) is specifically designed for PDD, offering a structured framework to foster a meaningful therapeutic relationship. However, its effectiveness in patients with attachment insecurities—commonly observed in PDD—remains unclear.

pmc-13263767.title: Combined effect of anxiety disorder and insomnia on the risk of incident ADRD diagnosis
pmc-13263767.creator: SangNam Ahn, Joanne Salas, Jinmyoung Cho, Jeffrey F. Scherrer
pmc-13263767.description: BackgroundAnxiety disorders and insomnia are common modifiable conditions in older adults, but their independent and combined effects on the risk of incident Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD) remain unclear.ObjectivesTo estimate the independent and combined associations of anxiety disorders and insomnia with the risk of incident ADRD.DesignRetrospective cohort study using an intention-to-treat approach with a 10-year follow-up period (2014–2023).

pmc-13361072.title: Cardiovascular Risk and Bone Mineral Density in Children with Familial Mediterranean Fever: The Role of Disease Severity and Genetic Mutations
pmc-13361072.creator: Emrah Çığrı, Funda Çatan İnan, Sedat Gülten, Fethiye Yildiz, Mehmet Akif Bildirici, Hilmi Onur Kabukçu, Eren Yildiz, Metin Asileren, Ayşe Ece Gökkaya, Elif Aksu, Eren Er
pmc-13361072.description: In the present study, cardiovascular risk indices (Atherogenic Index of Plasma [AIP], Atherogenic Coefficient [AC], Castelli Risk Index-1 [CRI-1], and Castelli Risk Index-2 [CRI-2]) and bone mineral density (BMD SDS) were evaluated in patients with Familial Mediterranean Fever (FMF), and the association of these parameters with disease severity and MEFV gene mutations was investigated.

pmc-13677199.title: Polymerase iota coordinates adaptation to replication stress in BRCA2-deficient mammary epithelial cells
pmc-13677199.creator: Kavya Vipparthi, Ariana Bellare, Resul Ozbilgic, Peter Bazeley, Nishtha Khanna, Fangfang Wang, Anand Bhushan, Liangqi Xie, Zahraa Al-Hilli, You-Wei Zhang, Mihriban Karaayvaz
pmc-13677199.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryBRCA2 deficiency induces chronic replication stress, yet how human mammary epithelial cells adapt before malignant transformation remains poorly understood. Here, we identify polymerase iota (Pol ι) as a context-dependent regulator of replication stress responses in BRCA2-deficient mammary epithelium. Single-cell transcriptomic analysis of preneoplastic breast epithelium from BRCA2 mutation carriers revealed enrichment of POLI-positive hormone-sensing cells, while BRCA2 depletion increased nuclear Pol ι in mammary epithelial models. Functionally, Pol ι promoted post-S-phase DNA synthesis specifically in BRCA2-deficient cells.
